title: Tolerances, One-Time Repairs, Cosmetic Items and Exclusions in the Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, cracks, one-time repairs, cosmetic surface items and conditions the homeowner or others caused are decided on the following bases, each with the figures of the home's HomeCare program.

**Cracks.** An inspected crack is within tolerance, and the item is denied with reason "within tolerance", when its measured width is below the program's flatwork concrete crack width figure for flatwork (and its vertical displacement below the flatwork displacement figure), below the foundation slab figure for the foundation slab, below the masonry figure for brick or stone veneer and below the drywall figure for drywall. A measurement equal to the tolerance is out of tolerance and covered.

| Flatwork crack measurement | Width below the width figure | Displacement below the displacement figure | Within tolerance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Both below | Yes | Yes | Yes: denied, within tolerance |
| Width equal to the figure | No | Yes | No: out of tolerance and covered |
| Displacement equal to the figure | Yes | No | No: out of tolerance and covered |

**One-time repairs.** Drywall nail pops and caulk or grout separation are repaired once each, up to the program's drywall nail pop visits and caulk and grout touch-up visits over the life of the home's coverage, and are denied with reason "one-time repair used" after that. These visits are counted across every owner of the home.

**Cosmetic surface items.** A cosmetic surface item (chips, scratches, stains on finished surfaces) is covered only when it is on the orientation list, or reported within the program's cosmetic report window, in calendar days after the coverage start date; otherwise it is denied with reason "cosmetic not noted".

**Caused by others.** Conditions caused by homeowner maintenance, homeowner alterations or third parties are denied with reason "homeowner maintenance" or "homeowner alteration".

**Retired clause.** The clause "An item already denied within tolerance that is re-reported and again measured within tolerance carries the program's reinspection fee" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the reinspection charge.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- A drywall crack measured at exactly 0.125 inch under a program whose drywall figure is 0.125 inch is out of tolerance and covered.
- In a program with one included caulk and grout touch-up visit, a second caulk separation item after that visit was used is denied as one-time repair used.

superseded_clauses: An item already denied within_tolerance that is re-reported and again measured within tolerance carries reinspection_fee_usd.
